title: Comparison result (one line of results.jsonl: one case, one method, one trial)

run_id.description: Identifier shared by the results of one run. Matches a line of runs.jsonl.

method.description: Method name. Names that start with agent_ are agent methods; all others are retrieval-only.

trial.description: 1-based repetition number. Agent methods: 3 trials. Retrieval-only methods: 1.

status.description: completed: produced an answer or a result list. timeout: hit the per-case time limit. gave_up: ended without an answer.

retrieved_evidence.description: Retrieval-only methods: the ranked passages returned. Agent methods: files and lines the agent opened or cited, in order of first appearance.

search_time_ms.description: Retrieval-only methods: latency of the search call with the index and model already loaded. Agent methods: null.

answer.description: Agent methods: the final answer. Retrieval-only methods: null.

answer_correctness.description: Score under the rubric fixed before the run: a number from 0 to 1, or acceptable / unacceptable. null until scored.

task_time_seconds.description: Agent methods: wall-clock time from sending the question to the final answer.

ai_units.description: Billing units reported by the agent host (for Copilot: AI credits), when known.

cost_usd.description: Estimated cost when tokens are billed by a provider directly. The price table goes in runs.jsonl.

tool_calls.description: Number of tool calls the agent made.

model_calls.description: Number of model requests the agent made.

returned_bytes.description: Bytes of tool output handed to the model. Retrieval-only methods: size of the agent-format output for this query. Agent methods: total over all tool results.

offloaded_results.description: Agent methods: tool results the host did not pass to the model because they were too large (saved to a file instead).

session_id.description: Key for joining with an external session log.

tools_by_name.description: Agent methods: number of calls per tool, by the name the host uses (for example view, Read, lsp, mcp__serena__find_symbol).

stale.description: true when the file changed after the index was built.

origin.description: search_result: returned by a search call. opened: a file range the agent read. cited: named as evidence in the answer. symbol_result: the body of a symbol that a code-intelligence tool (Serena, a language server) returned.
